action_description: Replaced the staged one-output-per-thread serial dot loops with a local-route grouped CUDA path and CTA-level tiled GEMM-style kernels. Routes are compacted by local expert, stage 1 computes gate/up FP4 dot products over 8x16 route/intermediate tiles with 4-way cooperative K-split reductions and applies SwiGLU in FP32, and stage 2 computes down-projection tiles with the same cooperative split into a FP32 accumulation buffer before bf16 finalization.
